messages:
Ava (CS): Heads-up — we just got reports from three onboarding customers that their Dedicated pools are returning 401/invalid-token when trying the initial embed + inference flow. Affected: AcmeAnalytics, BrightForms, NovaDocs. I flagged with eng and ops. Need a short status comms to send to each account and a note for renewal-risk customers.
Diego (CS): Thanks. Any idea if this is a config drift or a credential rotation issue?
Mira (Eng Liasion): Quick summary from runtime: we rolled a secret refresh last night for pooled keys and one deploy didn't pick up the new KMS alias, so token validation fails for certain pool IDs. Triage ticket created: INF-7789.
SupportBot: Incident INF-7789 created by mira. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7789 — status: investigating.
Ava (CS): Ok — Diego can you draft two short notes: 1) for general affected onboarding users (explain symptom + ETA) 2) for 2 renewal-risk accounts (AcmeAnalytics & NovaDocs) with offer of credit and technical handoff. Keep it <4 sentences.
Diego (CS): Draft 1: "Hi — we're investigating an authentication issue affecting Dedicated pools causing failed requests with 401. Our engineers have identified a secret refresh not applied to some pool instances; we're rolling a fix now. We'll update in ~30–45 minutes and will follow up with the root cause once confirmed. Sorry for the disruption." Thoughts?
Raj (AE): For renewal-risk wording, add a line: "We recognize the timing impacts your evaluation — we'd like to offer a one-month credit and a direct session with our eng team to assist cutover." That helps churn risk.
Liam (Onboarding): Can we include a quick workaround for customers who need to continue tests? Maybe create a temp API key they can use while we patch?
Mira (Eng Liasion): Workaround: generate a scoped admin key for the customer and add to their pool config; CLI: `rwctl keys create --scope pool:<POOL_ID> --ttl 2h`. I'll coordinate with OpsDesk. Note: scoped keys bypass the KMS alias path used by the auto-rotate flow, so ephemeral keys are safe as a stopgap.
OpsDesk: I'll prepare ephemeral keys and DM the three customers' CS leads. Need the pool IDs — @Ava can you send?
Ava (CS): Pool IDs: AcmeAnalytics -> pool-7b3, BrightForms -> pool-c1a, NovaDocs -> pool-df9. Sending DM now.
Diego (CS): Draft 2 (renewal-risk): "Hi <Name>, we encountered an authentication issue in your Dedicated pool during onboarding tests. We're deploying a fix and can provision an interim scoped key so your evaluation continues uninterrupted. We value your trial and would like to offer a one-month credit plus a 1:1 with our engineering team to ensure a smooth handoff. — Ava & Team"
Raj (AE): That reads well. Add: "If you prefer immediate rollback to previous key config, we can also perform that within the hour."
Ava (CS): Good call. I'll send both messages out and tag updates in the customer ticket. Diego — please post the final comms in the CS shared drive and paste the link here.
Diego (CS): Done: https://drive.redwood.com/cs/onboarding/comms/1912345678-dedicated-auth-comms.md
Mira (Eng Liasion): Patch rollout started at `2026-03-21T15:10:00Z`. Rolling restart of affected pool controllers in batches; estimated full recovery by +35 minutes. Will update.
SupportBot: INF-7789 status: fix-deploying -> partial-recovery.
Ava (CS): Sending customer notes now. I'll follow up with renewal-risk accounts personally. Please update when patches finish so I can close the customer loop. :thumbsup:
Mira (Eng Liasion): Patch finished at `2026-03-21T15:40:12Z`. Post-deploy checks show token validation succeeding for pool-7b3, pool-c1a, pool-df9. Will run 30m sampling.
SupportBot: INF-7789 resolved by mira. RCA draft: secret refresh job used older KMS alias in one zone causing validation mismatch. Permanent fix: add alias sync + rollout gate to secret-rotate pipeline.
Ava (CS): Thanks all — I'll update the customers with RCA + goodwill credit details. Filing follow-up items in INF-7789 and CS risk tracker.
Raj (AE): I'll log the credit so finance knows. Ping me if any customer pushes back.
Diego (CS): Quick feedback capture idea: add a one-question survey to the comms: "Did this incident materially affect your evaluation? (Yes/No)" — helps quantify.
Ava (CS): Nice — include that. Closing thread after customer replies come in.
